release_notes:
• Tapping the mini player (or the song title) now opens the full player and keeps the song playing; hold the bar for song details
• Three new player pages: Spotify (artwork card, left-aligned details, thin seek bar), Immersive (full-screen artwork, overlaid controls) and Minimal (text only)
• Player Page Style in Settings -> Player UI & Customizer is now a proper list of all seven arrangements with a tick on the active one
